title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 19: I Was You

scenes.say: A veterans job fair. You're the guy who wrote that book, right?
scenes.visual: a community center job fair with veterans gathering, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Young vets start forming around him.
scenes.visual: a crowd of young veterans around one man, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: When your story touches others, it ain't just yours anymore.
scenes.visual: hands reaching out for a handshake, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ms. James again. Softer now. You've come a long way. Still got miles to go.
scenes.visual: two chairs in a sunny therapy room, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: True. But you're not walking alone anymore.
scenes.visual: a genuine handshake in a bright office, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Night. Two boys fighting in the street. Ali breaks it up.
scenes.visual: a man pulling apart two teenage boys under a streetlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: This how y'all want to end up? Dead or in a cell?
scenes.visual: a city street at night, tense moment in silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You don't know our life! I am your life. I was you.
scenes.visual: a man standing between two boys, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
an empty street under a streetlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a streetlight flickering on at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 19 of 25: I Was You. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
